Dear [${deskPlaceHolders.tickets.cf_agent_name_1}],

We are writing to formally inform you that we found you have taken an action mistakenly against (the wrong action/issue taken). We have found that an issue accrued through your chat with the client and have found a critical error impacting the business. However, so we are raising this one to bring your attention to avoid any further incidents to avoid impacting the business growth.

Details of the Complaint:
• Description of the Problem: ${deskPlaceHolders.tickets.description}
• PNR: ${deskPlaceHolders.tickets.cf_pnr}
• Chat ID: ${deskPlaceHolders.tickets.cf_chat_id}
• Corrective Action/QA Feedback: ${deskPlaceHolders.tickets.resolution}

Expected Resolution:
To address this issue, I would appreciate your attention to the above to avoid any repetitive incidents.

Please let me know if you need any additional information from our end. I look forward to your prompt response and a resolution to the mentioned issue.


Sincerely,
Quality Assurance Department
